segments.title: Cold Open: Pepito Sign-On & Case Returns
segments.notes: Pepito delivers the station sign-on; Case joins recovering from illness, Hype Train appears in translucent ghost mode.

segments.title: Chat News Desk: Hegseth, Mad Men 4K, Waymo, AI Jesus, Poison Pills, Anime Dubs, GOG Horses, OpenAI, Pavarotti Statue, Pikmin Bloom
segments.notes: Case and Jeff Ripple cover viewer-sourced stories: Pete Hegseth Signal investigation and Yemen strike double-tap, Mad Men 4K vomit tube visible, Waymo police stop, Joe Rogan AI Jesus claims, Facebook AI poison pills, Amazon AI anime dubs, GOG hosting Horses after Steam ban, OpenAI profitability timeline, Pavarotti statue in ice rink, Pikmin Bloom revenue.

segments.title: Debate: Sleeping in Cabinet Meetings as Strength
segments.notes: Munch and Crum clash over whether the president dozing in cabinet meetings projects dominance; Crum confesses to sabotaging his lawyer's Thanksgiving at Denny's.

segments.title: How To: Promise Rings, Viral Cocktails, Baking Soda Erection Hack, Elmo Eggnog
segments.notes: Jeb and his wooden-board father host relationship coach Sally Landau on promise rings, then review viral cocktails, a baking soda ED debunking, and Elmo making eggnog.

segments.title: Science Eyes: Leaf-Mimic Spider, AI Hospital, Baseball Drugs, Borax Enema
segments.notes: Chet and ChetAI analyze a Vietnamese spider mimicking dead leaves, a Chinese AI-run hospital, a baseball player's drug use, and a borax/aged-urine enema video that triggers content filters.

segments.title: Amongst the Web: Big Bill Hell's, Racist Bathroom, AR AI Buddy, Bottle Draining, Knife Carrot, Ceiling Fan Tragedy, Macy's Parade
segments.notes: Rick hosts the viral video review: Big Bill Hell's car dealership ad, racist bathroom decor, AR AI companion, suggestive bottle pouring, knife precision carrot eating, ceiling fan couple separation, Macy's Thanksgiving Parade rap.

segments.title: Sign-Off: Failed Raid Attempt on Steph Woodburn
segments.notes: Case and Pepito attempt a raid; Pepito feigns ignorance, chat suggests Steph Woodburn, raid executes as Case accuses Pepito of sabotage.

episode_summary: Barely Informed News returned from a week-long hiatus with Case Blackwell and much of the studio staff recovering from illness. The broadcast cycled through a chat-driven news desk, a Munch & Crum debate on presidential somnolence, a chaotic How To with Jeb featuring promise rings and baking soda erection hacks, a Science Eyes segment on biomimetic spiders and AI hospitals, and Rick's Amongst the Web debut reviewing viral atrocities. The episode closed with a failed raid attempt as Pepito claimed the network had no one left to raid.
